name: Missouri
feeText: Statewide consolidated court costs for a circuit civil case are $83.50 (Missouri courts Schedule of Consolidated Amount, effective November 1, 2023); local surcharges are added by each circuit, and the total charged for a dissolution petition in St. Louis County was not found on an official page.

otherFees.what: Statewide consolidated amount, circuit civil case (excluding local surcharges), effective 2023-11-01

waiver.name: Request to proceed as a poor person (RSMo § 514.040)

residency.text: One party must have been a resident of Missouri, or stationed there in the armed services, for 90 days immediately before the proceeding began (RSMo § 452.305.1(1)).

waitingPeriod.text: The court may enter a judgment of dissolution only if thirty days have elapsed since the petition was filed (RSMo § 452.305.1(1)).

simplified.text: No summary dissolution procedure was found in chapter 452.

parentingClass.text: Circuit courts must establish, by local rule, a program of educational sessions for parties to dissolution actions or post-judgment proceedings involving custody or support (RSMo § 452.600); whether attendance is mandatory depends on the circuit's local rule.

uncertain: St. Louis County (most populous) dissolution filing fee and any answer fee: not found on an official page (stlcountycourts.com archived pages list only administrative orders); filingFee and responseFee are null.
The $83.50 consolidated amount was read from the Internet Archive 2026 copy of the official courts.mo.gov PDF; it may have been updated after November 1, 2023.
Waiver: no statewide form title was read; the statute is cited instead.
Parenting class: the 21st Circuit local rule was not read.
